comments.author: @PicknTime
comments.text: As a man from rural Mississippi, when I watch this video and listen to the author, I first separate what I see from what I hear, and then judge each on their own. First, in the video I can see the poverty and lack of modern infrastructure, and amenities. I can somewhat relate to this from my childhood in 1950s MS.  Second, the author isn’t disparaging the people, but is commenting on their environmental and physical surroundings and conditions, which may contribute to a short life span and other health issues. What he is saying and what we can see is found in many countries, including the U.S., but for different causes and magnitude. I think it’s good some attention is brought to the plight of the people of Burundi, and hopefully they can begin using their natural resources to better the lives of the people with electric power, running water, better food, infrastructure and housing. These are the things most every human wants, inclusing you and I, but many in this world find it hard to get.
